pub struct Wrapper<T> {
    v: T,
}

impl<T: Default> Wrapper<T> {
    pub fn new() -> Wrapper<T> {
        loop {}
    }

    pub fn never_called(&self) {}
}

fn orphan() {}

use utils::{helper, deep::leaf};

    Wrapper::<Vec<u8>>::new();
}
